name: Belize Barrier Reef Reserve System
description: Running about 300 kilometres along Belize's Caribbean coast, this is the largest barrier reef in the northern hemisphere. Alongside the reef you'll find three offshore atolls, hundreds of sandy cays and tangled mangrove forests. Divers and snorkellers come for its walls and pinnacles and for the Great Blue Hole, while turtles, manatees and crocodiles shelter here.
